entries.name_han: 道教仪式的音乐学研究
entries.logic_thesis: Musicological method can recover Daoist ritual logic because sound patterns systematically encode cosmology, hierarchy, and transformation sequences.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Ritual claims to transform status of persons and spirits. 2) Transformation is paced by musical sections. 3) Analysis of pitch, form, and performance practice reveals implicit cosmology. 4) Cross-region comparison separates core grammar from local color. 5) Sound data thus becomes evidence for religious structure. 6) Music study is not ornament study but structure study.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Treat BaZi as a score: stems = melody, branches = rhythm/roots. 2) Identify the chart's key (dominant agent) and modulations (luck pillars). 3) Locate cadences—years when冲合 resolves tension—for decisive moves. 4) Read clashes as dissonance requiring preparation (印/食 mediation). 5) Design yearly plans as movements with exposition, development, close.

entries.logic_thesis: Chinese religious practice is centered on ritual doing—correct exchange among living, dead, and gods—rather than on exclusive dogma.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Social and cosmic order are maintained by reciprocal rites. 2) Family, community, and specialists share ritual labor. 3) Efficacy is judged by proper form and relationship repair, not confession alone. 4) Multiple traditions can coexist in one ritual economy. 5) Therefore religion is practiced as etiquette of the cosmos. 6) Understanding Chinese religion means mapping ritual obligations.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Prioritize relationship stars (财官印食) as ritual counterparts, not isolated Day Master heroics. 2) Schedule ancestral/family matters when印库 or resource months open. 3) Treat career as 'serving an office' (官) with offerings of competence (食伤/财). 4) Repair clash years with mediating合 and human protocols, not denial. 5) Read empty/void as incomplete rite—fill with preparation before demand.
entries.logic_compare: Widest anthropological frame among the ten. Provides social grammar that Taiwan Daoist music studies specialize. Less technical on liturgy than朝科/拔度, more on why rites matter for Chinese personhood.

entries.logic_thesis: Primary ritual scripts, registers, and field records are the evidentiary base for any claim about how Taiwanese Daoism actually works.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Secondary summaries drift from practice. 2) Local manuscripts fix wording, sequence, and offices. 3) Comparing sources reveals lineage branches and change. 4) Music, talismans, and liturgy must be read together. 5) Documentation enables transmission and critique. 6) Data precedes theory; without texts, ritual claims float.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Build chart reading on primary factors (stems/branches/hidden stems) before lore. 2) Keep a case log: prediction, timing, outcome—your 'field corpus'. 3) Cross-check any school rule against multiple charts, not one anecdote. 4) Separate classic rules, local customs, and modern inventions. 5) Update methods only when records force revision.
entries.logic_compare: Source-corpus counterpart to interpretive monographs on Taiwan ritual music. Enables verification of claims in朝科,拔度, and talisman books. Less argumentative thesis, more archival logic of proof.

entries.name_han: 江西龙虎山天师道科仪
entries.logic_thesis: Celestial Masters liturgy at Longhu Mountain institutionalizes cosmic bureaucracy: correct petition order and register authority make the rite legally effective in Heaven's offices.
entries.logic_chain: 1) The cosmos is administered as ranked offices. 2) The Celestial Master lineage holds registers and seals of authorization. 3)科仪 sequences formal petitions, memorials, and dismissals. 4) Without proper warrant, prayers lack administrative force. 5) Community welfare depends on this bureaucratic mediation. 6) Liturgy is celestial administrative procedure performed on earth.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Read官杀 as Heaven's office;印 as warrant/seal;财 as filing fee/resources. 2) Launch petitions (job apps, legal, promotions) when seal protects officer. 3) Avoid 'unregistered' moves—goals with no supporting structure in chart. 4) Use combination years as 'memorial accepted' windows. 5) Treat mentors/institutions as龙虎山-like authority nodes in the chart.
entries.logic_compare: Most explicitly bureaucratic among the set; pairs with符式簿's command tech and朝科's audience form. More orthodox Zhengyi than Lushan martial传度. Differs from music studies by centering text-register legality over sonic form.

entries.logic_thesis: Salvation liturgy liberates stuck souls by converting suffering into ordered passage through confession, refinement, and escorted rebirth or ascent.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Death can leave beings trapped by debt, grievance, or disorder. 2) Living sponsors open a ritual path of release. 3) Texts and performance purify, instruct, and reclassify the soul. 4) Escorts and warrants guarantee safe transit across realms. 5) Successful拔度 restores balance for both dead and living lineage. 6) Mercy is operationalized as procedural transformation.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Identify 'stuck' chart patterns: heavy冲刑, weak resource, blocked output. 2) Sequence repair: first stabilize (印/比劫 support), then release (食伤/动), then re-place (官/财 new role). 3) Time grief, therapy, or debt clearing to water/resource flow months. 4) Do not force major expansion while the chart is still in 'purgatorial' clash without mediation. 5) Treat ancestral/family unresolved issues as part of personal luck hygiene.
entries.logic_compare: Opposite vector to martial exorcism: salvage and transit rather than expulsion alone. Shares bureaucratic warrants with天师道科仪 but aims at the dead's reclassification. More soteriological than music monographs, which describe how the rite sounds.

entries.logic_thesis: Audience liturgy stages the correct approach to divine court: purification, entry, presentation, petition, and withdrawal must follow court protocol or the audience fails.
entries.logic_chain: 1) Sacred power is modeled as a royal/heavenly court. 2) Approach requires purity and proper rank signals. 3) Memorials are presented in fixed order with sonic and textual cues. 4) Response is invited, then the assembly withdraws without offense. 5) Protocol itself is the condition of communication. 6) Ritual is political etiquette transposed to the cosmos.
entries.logic_practice: 1) Frame any high-stakes ask as朝: prepare (印), enter (合/通关), present (食伤 articulation), request (对官财), exit (don't overstay clash). 2) Time audiences with superiors to days when Day Master is clean (no severe day-clash) and officer is visible. 3) Use hour as the 'entry drum' after day selection. 4) If chart lacks seal, borrow external credentials before petition. 5) After success, schedule a consolidation month—ritual withdrawal as aftercare.
entries.logic_compare: Most protocol-focused sibling of天师道科仪; smaller unit than full拔度 salvation programs. Aligns with中国人的宗教仪礼 on etiquette of exchange. Music studies explain how朝 is paced;朝科 explains why the order of approach matters.
